notes.title: Update v2.0.4 DLC - Balancing and fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Vikings!

We’re back with a new DLC balancing and fixing update. We are always reading your comments and feedback, and we really appreciate them.



ːNA_CrystalːYou’ve been sharp as a knife with your feedback (and with good reason). Instead of receiving it as a defeat, we will keep updating until the game feels as it should.

ːNA_CrystalːIt is our duty to make this DLC fun and rewarding and we won’t abandon its development.


Balancing and fixes
This update will focus on balancing Normal, Difficult and Expert and a few touches of Hardcore. Next week we will focus on Hardcore and Endless.

Here are the changes and fixes we’ve made:

The rarity of weapon stat upgrades now depends on their level. This means that at level 1 they will grant common upgrades, at level 3 they will grant rare upgrades, etc.

As you climb the tower floors, the weapons you collect will appear at a higher level.

The ultimate ability is now upgraded on specific floors: 11 and 31. If you use a shortcut, this upgrade is still obtained.

The experience curve has been adjusted. Now, every time you increase a character's level 50 times, the level upgrades increase in quality.

You can disable the automatic opening of stats when leveling up. You can open the panel at any time by pressing the F key /select button.

Meta-progress corruption has been significantly reduced. Upgrades that improve stats no longer increase corruption.

You can accumulate level points without spending them and then use them in the level-for-gold exchanger in Gnöki's room (unlocked in Helheim).

Item's price cannot exceed 99 gold due to inflation

Any character can use a shortcut door as long as it has been unlocked in the meta-progression.

Scroll has been fixed in the constellation.

When defeating a boss, weapon upgrades do not count as a level-up, but rather as a bonus upgrade.

Other minor fixes and UI improvements.

 

Thanks again, we will check back in a few days with some more fixes and exciting news!!

Cheers!

notes.notes:
Hello vikings!

Today as promised, we have a seed update! ːNA_Seedː ːNA_Seedː ːNA_Seedː
There’s always a moment where you don’t know what to do with your seeds anymore, so we needed to do something about it. And even if you still haven’t exchanged all the available leaves for seeds, we think you will enjoy this update very much too!

Seed plants
The first announcement is that you will find seed plants across the realms! That way you will be able to earn many more seeds on each run. Hit them a few times to earn seeds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/bb573eb6738a9058f76a8df95ec686caff316cd7.png

One of the reasons is that this way you can get a bunch of leaves faster, and the other one goes as follows:

Relic Exchange:
You will find a new tab on the main menu called Relic Exchange. In this panel you will be able exchange some of your seeds for relics which will appear at the beginning of your next run. These relics can be active and passive relics, but not Ancestral relics in any case (the ones belonging to each character). Up to 15 relics will appear.

You will see relic seed prices vary depending on their rarity. Each relic will also have an energy cost. You will be able to add up to 5 relics depending on their energy.
This way you may get 5 commons, or 2 epics, or 1 common 1 legendary, etc.
For a small amount of seeds you will be able to reroll the weapons that appeared. 
You may also lock relics by previously selecting them so they don’t reroll with the rest.
Once you’re done, just close the panel and the relics you selected will appear right when you start a new run.
These relics will only be available until your next run ends, so choose wisely.

You will need to earn 10k seeds to unlock this feature. 

Improvements

 Ragnarok VI and VII added to Custom Mode.

Fixes

 Immunity Knot relic didn't avoid you getting frozen in Jotunheim.


We hope you enjoy the new seed features!

As for next week, we will open Asgard beta! The last beta realm of the game!
Seed you soon :D ːNA_Seedː

notes.notes:
Hello vikings!

We're back after a few days off :D
While we develop Asgard we will also update every week with some content, mostly QoL.

On today's update you will find the following:

Difficulty
We’ve been working on optimizing early stages difficulty. This way new players won’t find the first realms too hard and the learning curve will be much smoother. This will apply to Midgard, Alfheim, Svartalfheim and Jotunheim.

Another realm that was too hard in comparison to the rest was Muspelheim, so we lowered their  HP and speed. If it still feels decompensated, please let us know.

Minimap
Structures are now shown in the mini map from the beginning of the adventure. This means that the Yggdrasil slot that upgraded this feature will be removed. This will help new players learn there are many areas you can interact with. And it’s also a good aid for any player!

Ascensions
You will now be able to ascend relics WHENEVER you want. They no longer have to be level 10. We believe this will make runs more fun and flexible.

Disclaimer: remember R.E.S.E.T. relic will reset your weapons back to level 1 when ascended. This means that, while owning R.E.S.E.T. during a run, if you reach level 10 and ascend your relic, it will have a total of 20 levels (nothing changes here). But if you ascend at level 3, your relic will only have a total of 13 levels.

Other Improvements

 Relics that do not synergize with those you own or your character can get in their constellation, will not appear in the shop or on shrines. For example: if you don’t have any thunder relics, passive relics related to thunder will not appear. This will happen as long as there are enough relics in the pool. If not, they will begin to appear.
 Gold mine shrine visually upgraded.
 UI changes on how many seeds you have in exchange for leaves in the Yggdrasil panel.
 UI changes related to the Constellation.
 The distribution of xp between regular mobs and elites has been homogenized in wave 1 to make leveling up easier.

Bugs

 Yggdrasil tree leaves should not reset anymore.
 In some cases, if doing a Daily Challenge from a realm you had not yet unlocked, many achievements were unlocked when they shouldn’t.
 Axeldör’s Thunder Armor 1st ascension was not working properly.
 Alfheim explosive slimes telegraph was not working properly.

notes.title: Update v0.13.6
notes.notes:
Hello vikings!!

Today we have a few improvements, challenging levels and a surprise we're sure you'll love!

Ragnarok Mode
Ragnarok levels will be available for all realms! We had the following left:
Ragnarok I-VII in Niflheim and in Muspelheim.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/076b3e49ec137a77cf27da2428b1671d60a0f59c.png

Nightmare Mode
We're also adding the rest of Nightmare mode realms! These are Niflheim and Muspelheim realms too. Ice and Fire Nightmares!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/47ae04c99433ddc26e121b552a3dd3dd73dd1812.png

New Shrine!
The gold mine has arrived at Nordic Ashes! This new shrine is exactly that, a place where gold will be mined second after second. For now, it will provide 1 gold coin every 30 seconds. You don’t need to do anything, just grab the money whenever you want. (I’m sure there will be an Yggdrasil upgrade at some point, but shhh).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/c7ab8cd16c53319127af653f949e604ef2795c9d.png

Anniversary Skins for Blud and Alruna
Last friday, December 15th was our 1 year anniversary since we launched Early Access! And what a better way to celebrate than to add Anniversary Skins for the remaining characters!
Yes, that's right! Blud and Alruna will now have their own Anniversary Skin! It will work as last time: conquer 3 realms with those characters to win their skins :D (these are all permanent skins).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/550e8fff6913400a02dd504d337da13a3af7548e.png

Skins from past events
Thanks all your feedback, we've decided to create new ways of getting character skins from past events in case you missed them.
You will now be able to get Amaranth Catrina skin by winning 5 runs with Amaranth. If you already have, your skin will be automatically unlocked.

Same will happen with Santa Talkor. Once the event is over (Jan 4th) you will be able to unlock it too.

We hope that with these changes, you won't feel FOMO or not being able to earn every achievement.
We will still keep part of the events as seasonal ones, because we think it's fun to have some variety. For example, Halloween Midgard will be available on October. But that's just as it happens in real life, everything is decorated in a spooky way only during October.

New Achievements
Since now you can get all the skins, we've created a new achievement for each of them ːNA_Crystalː

Improvements

 The quantity of enemies needed to obtain leaves has been reduced.
 Bosses and Final Bosses now grant more seeds.
 Max. seeds required in exchange for leaves has been reduced from 500 to 450.
 Seed drop rate has been increased.
 Players will now earn 5 leaves on their first run.

Fixes

 Axeldör’s Fire Boots (Brann) second ascension was not working.
 End panel scroll improvements.

Happy Holidays!
This will be the last update of the year as we will be taking 2 weeks off to rest all the new Asgard ideas and come back strong In January! We want to take all the time that requires to honor the last realm.
We hope you enjoy these holidays very much.

From the bottom of our hearts, we wish you the best and an amazing 2024! You are the best community ever! ːNA_Gnokiː

notes.title: Update v0.13.2
notes.notes:
Hello! ːNA_Leafː
Today we have a suggestions/fixes update related to your feedback :D

Improvements 

 If you touch the Gnöki Exchange Shrine (the one in the shop, that exchanges xp for gold) once and then step away, it will exchange xp for gold 1 time. But if you stay close, it will exchange xp for gold multiple times, faster each time. 
 If you already have the maximum gold, it won’t keep exchanging xp for nothing even if you stay close.
 This exchange shrine will also appear in the room before the final boss.
 Changed the color of the timer that appears on the bottom center of the screen during runs so you can see it better.
 You can now hide the UI during runs in case you want to take a screenshot pressing F9 or the left joystick. 
 Manual aim (mouse): we’ve slightly changed how it works and we hope it is now more intuitive. It will aim at you enemies while you keep it pressed.
 Green hearts will now appear always in last position. This way you will lose them first when you get hit, as they grant you xp when they break.

Alruna balancing

 To make unlocking her more intuitive, it will now be on Niflheim Realm. As ice potions are unlocked in this realm, it will make things more straight forward.
 And speaking of Ice Potions. We’ve also changed the probability of them appearing on the shop, so they are easier to obtain. Before, red potions were Common and the others were Rare. Now they all have the same % of appearing.
 Her weapon Selenite Wand, has now manual aim too.
 If your character has earned penetration stats, Selenite Wand will have them too.
 Alruna’s Ultimate ability: she will summon one extra Gunborg every 5 summons on her global stats.
 The Mandrake’s cry area is now larger.
 Splintered Bones have now a larger area. Their initial duration has been changed from 2 to 3.
 Splintered Bones caused bleeding, but it was not specified in their description. Now it is.
 Updated Alruna’s minions descriptions.

Hansi balancing

 Crimson Dagger had a random target. It now targets nearby enemies.
 Deep Crystal now starts with 2 projectiles instead of 1 and the area of effect is larger. It also targets enemies more efficiently.
 Shadow Crossbow has now faster projectiles but they last less and have less attack speed. It now targets the closest enemies.
 Shadow Warrior also targets now the closest enemies.

Effects visibility tutorial
We’ve added a new tutorial. In case your abilities crowd the screen and you can’t see what’s below them (the ground, your enemies…), you can always reduce their alpha so they become more transparent and you can see through them.

Fixes

 There was a know bug that made some bosses or enemies immortal. This should now be fixed.
 Alruna’s Splintered Bones relic was not aiming correctly.
 Sometimes, Alruna’s stats regarding her innate ability were not being added correctly when you leveled up.


We hope you enjoy this update!
Next week we will introduce Winter Season!!
Have a nice day and see you very soon! ːNA_Crystalː

notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Todays update comes with 2 new Game Modes and balances overall difficulty of the game.

Daily Challenge
Find a new challenge every day. In this new game mode, you will be able to compete with other players to see who makes the best time or just challenge yourself and see how far you can go. 
This game mode has the following features:

 All players will play in the same conditions, same shrines, relics, survivor, realm, etc...
 We want everyone to have the same opportunities, therefore, all content is unlocked. However, you won’t be able to unlock new content for your regular runs or the glossary.
 You will be rewarded with 500 extra seeds and a Gnöki Badge the first time you complete a challenge each day.
 These runs have restrictions, such as no shrines or crates among others. Curses, Enemy Modifiers and Enemy Abilities may appear, making the run more challenging.
 In return, you will be aided by powerful blessings that will grant unique abilities.
 You will have a specific Yggdrasil each day, with a 100 leaves to spend.
 Leaderboard will be updated every day at 00:00 UTC.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/bf6c06f8444a8c0cf4233cb017991883c5e7a74d.png
In future updates we will be releasing new Blessings, Curses and Restrictions. As always, we will be happy to read all your suggestions and ideas to create new content!

Custom Mode
Many of you have been asking for the possibility of making a run with your own custom parameters and being able to ban relics, so here we go! 
First, choose a survivor, realm and difficulty. 
Then, you will be able to set some restrictions, such as disabling Yggdrasil or not being able to ascend, among others.

And what you were all waiting for… We have added the possibility of banning relics, as many as you want (you must have unlocked them in the Glossary and picked them up in a run at least once).

The seed drop % will vary depending on the restrictions and bans you have chosen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/ffafb400347bd5ed46aed4fd11ad37af21d999fc.png

We will be adding new parameters with which you will be able to customize your game in future updates. Please feel free to add any suggestions in the comments below! 


Difficulty balancing
We have readjusted the difficulty of all Realms as there are still 4 to come and we don’t want the game to feel impossible to beat lol. Enemy health in both Jotunheim and Vanaheim was too high compared to previous stages. This will make Ragnarok difficulty scale better too.

Bosses in Rage mode won’t have their movement speed or size increased anymore. The only stat that will increase will be the damage they deal. 

We have also reduced enemy Giantism ability and reduced the speed at which they grow. It is now limited to a maximum, preventing bosses from getting extremely large.

 Legendary Relic Beam Pyramid damage was not being tracked.
 Pause panel tooltips were not being displayed properly. 
 Tooltips were not being displayed properly.
 After defeating a Raid Shrine boss there was a bug with the music.
 In-game glossary was not working properly

Hello everyone! Today we bring you a patch that balances the game and fixes a few bugs. It also introduces new changes on Shrines and Yggdrasil.

Shrines 
We have modified how shrines are displayed in runs. Previously, all the Shrines appeared from the beginning. Now, at the start of the game you will have 4 Common Shrines available that can give you Common or Rare relics. After defeating the first boss and returning from Gnöki’s Realm, 2 new Rare Shrines will appear, which will give you Rare or Epic relics. Finally, after defeating the second boss and returning from Gnöki, a new Epic Shrine will appear, which will grant you an Epic relic.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/da2fc9e2fbe62eae371274f611232dc9e434e88f.png
The rarity of the Shrines will affect the requirements of each one of them.

With this change you will always have something to do when you return from Gnöki.

Yggdrasil
The Shrine update affects Yggdrasil too. Some power-ups have been modified and some new ones have been added. Above all, the last upgrade in the Buildings branch has been changed, and we are really looking forward for you to try it. With this upgrade, after you complete a Shrine, there will be a 25% chance that the Shrine will activate again, so you can get another reward. PS: it also affects the Ascension Shrine ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/280389a127691968d72a38c284029da0e4875f1d.png

The last power-up of the Healing branch has also received an upgrade. It can now be upgraded up to level 3, giving one extra resurrection per level.

And… Many of you have been asking for this feature: You’ll be able to save up to 5 different Yggdrasil builds! We hope this helps you a ton!

Balancing
Artifacts
Regarding artifacts, there still be more and more of them and the pool will get bigger and bigger, making it more difficult to get the ones you want. Therefore, we have made the following changes:

 When you reroll in Gnöki's Store you will always get a different potion, artifact, rune or chest.
 Gnöki's Store will now provide an extra artifact from Happiness level 3 onwards.
 Fire, Ice, Lightning, and Poison artifact cards still do not make the impact we’d like to. For now, we have raised their effect probability to 75% (previously 50%). With the next Realm release there will be new elemental synergies and these cards will have a higher power.
 The fireball artifact now releases several bursts of fire and more projectiles.


Survivors
Some survivors benefit from certain relics and others are of no use to them. We have made certain relics more likely to appear depending on the survivor you are playing. eg: Thyra will have more relics related to poison, Hafgrim with the 3 elements, Talkôr with gold...
This does not mean that the other relics will not appear, but they have less probability to do so.
Talkôr has undergone some improvements:

 Talkôr has two new relics in his constellation, which we know you're surely like.
 His ultimate can now also give you gold or artifacts when used.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/664e95d0dd676eb7258d65f7b0401d8728187d95.png

 Tarot deck: reduced the cooldown and the time it takes for each card to appear.

 Some shaders were not working correctly.
 The projectiles of the Alfheim fire slimes were not inflicting damage.
 Mama Bat no longer fires projectiles after she’s been defeated.

notes.title: NORDIC ASHES - Major Update - v0.5.0
notes.notes:
Nordic Ashes - Major Update

[previewyoutube=WKrnBC2IeV0;full][/previewyoutube]
With this update we wanted to distance our game from the rest of Survivor-themed games. We’ve decided to focus on the essence of the Roguelike genre, inspired by top games like The Binding of Isaac and Rogue Legacy among others, but not forgetting that fun part of Survivor games: the pressure of waves and the satisfaction of defeating many enemies at once, like in Vampire Survivors or 20 Seconds till Dawn.

As you all know, at first, we wanted to develop a more Roguelite game, with buffs between runs that made you more powerful each time. However, the Roguelike allows us to make a much deeper gameplay with more personality. It's a concept that excites us as game developers and we hope you like the result as much as we do.

The Roguelike has taken a great weight in our game and you will notice it when you play it. We really want to know what you think and your first impressions on all these new changes!

MIDGARD
The realm of Midgard has been redesigned bringing it to life. You will find beautiful ruins and vegetation scattered around the world.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/6770b679ccd8439416a3d91433a890f4ba79799a.png

Heart containers 
One of the most important changes that you will notice as soon as you start playing this new adventure is the vitality system. Each heart is now divided into 2 pieces, so each hit will only reduce half a heart container. This will allow you to last much longer. This change allows us to have better control the damage inflicted, although we warn you, beware of the bosses…
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/528c6e1a822870131c36fe7d4d41ce54086d7460.png
In addition to the Red Hearts, Blue Hearts, or Soul Hearts, have appeared. Unlike the red ones, once you lose them, you won't get them back unless you find specific items.

You will notice this change with Hafgrim in particular, since he now has just one red and one blue heart container, making it more difficult (but also more challenging) for him to survive. However, Axeldör and Thyra maintain the same number of life containers as before.

Secrets!
We want this Universe to be full of relics that allow you to play totally different runs each time.

Some of these relics will be available from the beginning and can be found in altars or in "alternate dimensions". However, you will have to complete multiple achievements in order to unlock them all!

Some relics have such powerful effects that can completely change the course of your run!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/af144247161c6ae9a0f1210508b612eef67495c7.gif

Altars!
Explore Midgard as fast as you can to find these mystical structures and get their rewards, be it relics or chests. This may decide the future of your survival.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/c09a0cc0c159d1eccc86b2e1a38ee96a5cee64d9.png

Gold!
There are multiple ways to obtain gold. You might earn a few coins by defeating enemies, but chances are you'll get a good handful from destroying wooden crates. You’ll soon learn why gold is so important in times of scarcity…
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/dbafd2cf60f3d7711fe4297c6d1e4f69d45d5dd1.png
Active and Passive Relics!
In the Yggdrasil Universe, you will be able to find many Relics. Broadly speaking, they can be divided into Active and Passive Relics. Active Relics can be leveled up to make them more powerful and are focused on defeating enemies. However, Passive Relics will grant you really useful upgrades.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/89813d36321e1593bacefda7f2830d8608265904.png

Glossary!
The Glossary gathers all the content of the Yggdrasil Universe. Here you’ll be able to see all the Secrets and Relics you have unlocked and those you still have to find.

[hr][/hr]
New content!

 New artifact! Azure Pendant, grants an Azure container (blue heart).
 5 new Potions!
 6 new Altars!
 +20 new Relics!
 +20 Secret Relics to discover!
 New Boss: Halvard the Destroyer!
 New Elites!

Enhanced User Experience

 Potions are no longer picked up if you have full health
 Movement of survivors improved, making it easier to change direction.
 Active Relics start at level 6 after you pick them up.
 You may now open the Constellation panel with the X button of the controller.
 You may now upgrade an ability with the space bar of the keyboard.

Improvements

 All weapons can now inflict critical damage.
 Chest rarity is now indicated by a colored outline.
 The Wave 4 Boss now appears in Wave 3.
 Waves 3 and 4 have been leveled.
 Golem animations have been updated.
 The Divine Shield Relic is now a Passive Relic, which cannot be upgraded, so its cooldown has been reduced.
 Axeldör's Ancient Relic, Berserker, is now Passive, once obtained it cannot be upgraded, but its duration has been increased.
 Thyra and Hafgrim have also received some buffs in their Ancient Relics.
 Game translated to Spanish

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/34690e30b1cba981807627deaa6d49e40b38d4e3.png
Last but not least, thanks so much to all our supporters. Our Discord community is growing every day.
Many improvements have been made thanks to the feedback given by you guys. We want to continue this journey hand in hand with you and create an amazing game to be remembered!💗

notes.notes:
New survivor!

The Ragnarök was no match for Hafgrim, all these years of experience made him survive with ease. Every element resides within him. He may seem old, but fire, thunder, and ice have never failed to answer his calling.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/ffd87407f510aa5432c11341e5f3c6106a243708.gif
Hafgrim has his own unique Constellation, different from Axeldör’s and Thyra’s.

Fjölkyngi Staff
Inferno Codex
Thunder Orb
Glacier Quartz

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42597961/0aeae70f9eeef846af982f0f8391e3d90b335a2b.png

With this new Survivor, a new feature has been added to the game: Status Effects! Check his Constellation to find how to Paralyze, Freeze and Burn your enemies!
Hafgrim has unique stats that make his gameplay completely different yet more challenging than other Survivors. He has 100% Cooldown reduction and 25% increase in Status Effect Probability for all the weapons he wields.

More features!

Weapons such as Thyra’s Poison Bomb can now Poison, Axeldör’s Brann can Burn and the Electric Rune has a probability of Paralyzing enemies.
Constellation Passive effects have been nerfed. They had too much impact in the game and although we want them to be useful we thought they were too powerful.
Thyra’s Poison Bomb was also too strong as it now applies Poison, so we have reduced the Duration upgrades. Don’t worry it’s still really powerful 😊
Chests have now a small probability of upgrading global stats such as Damage, Area, Duration… instead of a random equipment upgrade.
New Artifact: Heart Locket
Last but not least, 2 new Reliques have been added to the Altars!

Some upgrades!

In the endgame panel you can now see how many Chests you’ve opened and Rerolls you’ve made.
Added a basic tutorial for novice Survivors.
New option added to the Settings panel to remove Status Effects Texts to improve the performance in case you need it.
Twitch feature upgraded: you will now be able to select over which enemies your Chat names will appear (over minions, only bosses…).


The Gods are watching us… I forebode dark energy coming North… He may be here sooner than we thought…

Stay tuned for more updates on our Discord
